LESSON: COMPONENTS OF CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Foundations of Creative Arts and Sports
Topic 1.2: Components of Creative Arts and Sports

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Components of Creative Arts and Sports. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are the components of Creative Arts and Sports inter-related?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe elements of a story
2. perform activities demonstrating the components of fitness
3. write note values on a treble staff
4. name pitches on treble staff
5. group music notes in 2 4 time
6. appreciate the components of Creative Arts and Sports

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: COMPONENTS OF CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Components of Creative Arts and Sports helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: COMPONENTS OF CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Study Components of Creative Arts and Sports like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe elements of a story

What this means
In this part you learn to describe elements of a story. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe elements of a story.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Components of Creative Arts and Sports” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe elements of a story. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Components of Creative Arts and Sports is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Components of Creative Arts and Sports” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe elements of a story)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Components of Creative Arts and Sports in your own words. (skill: perform activities demonstrating the components of fitness)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: write note values on a treble staff)

Example 4: Show how “Components of Creative Arts and Sports” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: name pitches on treble staff)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Components of Creative Arts and Sports to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe elements of a story.
3. Practise this skill: perform activities demonstrating the components of fitness.
4. Practise this skill: write note values on a treble staff.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Components of Creative Arts and Sports from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Components of Creative Arts and Sports: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Components of Creative Arts and Sports?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are the components of Creative Arts and Sports inter-related?
2. How are components of Creative Arts and Sports applied?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Components of Creative Arts and Sports means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe elements of a story.
5. Be able to: perform activities demonstrating the components of fitness.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
